name: Grid
description: Cells in columns: a fixed count, or as many as fit the container at a minimum width.
signature: ({ as: Element, columns, gap, rowGap, align, className, style, children, ...rest }: GridProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: align
props.description: Vertical alignment of cells in their rows. Default: stretch.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: columns
props.description:
Columns: a fixed count, or `{ min }` for as many columns as fit at least `min` wide,
filling the container. `min` is a named width (GridMin) or any CSS length. Default `md`.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: role
props.description: An ARIA role when the container is a list, a group or a region.

props.name: rowGap
props.description: Row gap when it differs from the column gap.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style, merged after the layout's own variables.
